thread:
Ava (Head of GTM): Thanks everyone who joined today's all-hands — posting the sales/pipeline/partnerships Q&A here and capturing follow-ups. I'll drop short answers and action items. Ping me for clarifications. :mega:
Tom (Enterprise AE): Quick one — what's the plan for partner-led deals vs reps? clarification on credit and compensation.
Ava (Head of GTM): Good Q — short answer: partner-led for co-sell motion when partner brings >$100k ARR potential. We credit AE + partner 50/50 for first 120 days; comp plan docs linked in follow-up. @Jordan will share numbers.
Jordan (Sales Ops): I'll post the comp doc and the ARR thresholds. Also tracking: partner-sourced opps should be labeled `partner_source` in CRM to avoid double-counting.
Kelly (Partnerships): On enablement — first wave of self-serve integrations will be Marketplace + HubSpot connector. Pilot partners start next month. We expect 3 pilots by end of Q2.
Tom (Enterprise AE): How are we routing inbound partner leads? direct to partner ops or to reps?
Kelly (Partnerships): Inbound will flow to Partner Ops for qualification, then routed to regional reps. Low-touch referrals go to the SDR queue.
Lina (Product PM): Roadmap note — marketplace listing is gated on entitlements API (ETA 6 weeks). We're prioritizing the basic auth + provisioning flow first.
Sanjay (CEO): High-level: Partnerships are a force-multiplier. Expect headcount add (+1 bizdev +1 enablement) this quarter to scale pilots.
Tom (Enterprise AE): Any guidance on pipeline coverage targets from partnerships (ARR contribution expectations)?
Ava (Head of GTM): Target is 15% of new ARR from partners in 12 months, ramping from 0 -> 15% by next FY. Short-term metric: 3 pilots -> 1 production partner by EOY.
Jordan (Sales Ops): Action: I'll create a dashboard tile for partner-sourced pipeline and conversion rates. ETA: next Wed.
Lina (Product PM): Action for product: we will publish a partner API doc draft by Friday for review.
Kelly (Partnerships): Action: running partner office hours next Tues 10am PT — invite to be sent. Also onboarding checklist will be in Confluence.
Ava (Head of GTM): Follow-up doc: I'll post meeting notes + links to comp doc, partner checklist, and pilot list after this thread. If anyone needs a deeper sync, book 30m with me. :calendar:
all-hands-bot: Reminder — recording + slides available in #all-hands channel thread.
Tom (Enterprise AE): Thanks — will loop in two strategic partners for pilots. :thumbsup:
Kelly (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. tagging @Tom @Lina for handoffs; will DM next steps.
Ava (Head of GTM): Closing — love the momentum. We'll track actions and report progress in next all-hands.
